name: Puddling
lore: A wobbling drop of pond water with a face. Cornered it bursts; beaten, it spreads out and quietly steams away.

source.prompt: The round Poring blob from Ragnarök Online, but as water

attack.source_name: Angry water explosion then reappear from the groun

die.source_name: Turns into a puddle and and evaporates
